gameBlurb: Antventure is a 3D platformer game where you play as an ant on a quest to reclaim a stolen cookie from a greedy seagull. From the perspective of an insect, everyday environments become giant and dangerous playgrounds. Players must traverse kitchens, streets, and outdoor areas, overcoming hazards and using the unique ability to summon fellow ants to solve puzzles, cross obstacles, and ultimately confront the seagull in a final showdown.
